Team —

Quick reminder: the board packet appendix (ARR and bookings breakdown) lands with Investors next Friday. Finance needs final stage hygiene and commit confirmations for the cohort of deals in the ARR corridor so we can certify numbers. I pulled the list for DEAL-9871 (CloudScale) and a few others into the shared workbook.

Please do the following by EOD Tuesday (Aug 24):
- Update HubSpot stage to either "Commit" or "At-Risk" for each listed opportunity.
- Upload minimal evidence to the Drive folder (PO, signed SOW, recent email thread) and paste the file name in the spreadsheet.
- If close date slips >30 days or probability changed >=20%, flag the row and add a 1-line rationale.

Key piece: for ARR certification we need a single doc per deal that shows signee + commercial terms (price/term) or a committed legal redline plus procurement timeline. If you expect delays on CloudScale, call it out now — procurement has asked for a 30-day runway.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcdExampleBoardAppendix
Workbook: CS-StageEvidence-CloudScale.xlsx (tab: DEAL-9871)
HubSpot: hs_deal_9871

Thanks — I’ll consolidate and hand to Finance on Wed morning.

Connor O'Brien
Head, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: CS-StageEvidence-CloudScale.xlsx (staged, update required)
